https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: DESCRIPTION
Identifier for the audit report
Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) of the auditee
Year the audit was conducted
Date when the FAC accepted an audit
The award reference number as listed in SF-SAC Section 1: Federal Awards. Award references will be formatted “AWARD-####”.
Unnamed: 2: FAC system generated sequence number used to link to Findings data between CFDA/ALN Info and Findings

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Two-digit prefix identifying the federal awarding agency
Unnamed: 2: For programs with no ALN or if the ALN is Unknown, a "U" will appear followed by a two-digit number (e.g. U12) to identify one or more Federal award lines that form the program.

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Additional identifier for the federal award
Unnamed: 2: If the Federal program is part of the Research and Development (R&D) cluster and the three-digit ALN extension is unknown, an "RD" will appear. If the Federal program is part of the R&D cluster and the ALN Three-Digit Extension is known, the ALN will appear.

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Other data used to identify the award which is not a CFDA/ALN number
Unnamed: 2: For example--program year, contract number, state issued numbers, etc. This field is required if: an unknown ALN Three Digit Extension (e.g. U12) in the ALN field is entered or "RD" is entered for the ALN Three Digit Extension in the ALN field. This field should be blank if there is a known CFDA/ALN.

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Name of the federal program that provided the funding
Total amount of federal funds expended for an award
Unnamed: 2: Rounded to the nearest whole dollar

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Name of the cluster to which this federal award belongs
Unnamed: 2: If the program isn't part of a cluster, "N/A" will appear. If the program is part of a state cluster, “State Cluster” will appear. If the cluster name isn't on the drop-down list, "Other Cluster Not Listed Above" will appear.

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: The name of the cluster (if not listed in the compliance supplement)
State-designated cluster name if applicable
Unnamed: 2: If the program is part of a state cluster, the State Cluster name will appear. If the program isn't part of a state cluster, this will be blank.

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Total federal awards expended for each cluster in the audit
Total amount of federal funding for the specific program
Indicates if the award is classified as a major program
Unnamed: 2: If the Federal program is a major program, "Y" will appear, then either letter "U, Q, A, or D" will appear for "audit_report_type": U=Unqualifed, Q=Qualified, A=Adverse, D=Disclaimer. This field will be blank or "N" if not a major program.

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Indicates if the award is a loan
Outstanding loan balance at the end of the audit period, if applicable
Indicates if the funding was received directly from a federal agency or from a pass-through entity
Unnamed: 2: "Y" if the award came directly from a Federal awarding agency. "N"  if award did not come directly from a Federal awarding agency (i.e. "N" if the award came from a passthrough entity)

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Type of report issued on the major program compliance
Number of audit findings for the federal program
Unnamed: 2: Only available for audit years 2013 and beyond

https://api.fac.gov/federal_awards: Indicates if part or all of the award was passed by auditee to a subrecipient
Amount of funding passed by auditee to subrecipient

FEDERAL AWARDS ENDPOINT: NOTE: Additional passthrough information appears on the Passthrough endpoint
